champion.scope: Infers put conflict mode, trigger presence, and channel from calibration receipts by simulating the 18-member family; predicts channel, committed_count, or committed_sum for new sequences only when all consistent candidates agree.
champion.lesson: The source uses INSERT OR REPLACE (or upsert) with no trigger and main changes() channel: repeated put on same key yields channel 1 and committed value 2; rollback restores prior committed state; other-connection writes are visible to committed reader but not counted by main changes().
